approval_rule: Set approved to true only in a reviewed commit, before any final test data is downloaded. After the test set is opened, nothing in this file may change.
cutoff_rationale: Proposed. Latest earlier activity: raw-pipeline run generated 2026-08-31T14:53:06Z (raw_training_metrics.json); baseline run 2026-08-31T06:02:06Z; Tranco list entry dated 2026-08-30. Rows observed at or before the cutoff are removed.

sampling.method: balanced_downsample: after cleaning, sort each class by normalized URL, then draw min(n_legitimate, n_phishing) rows from each class without replacement using random.Random(seed).sample (legitimate first, then phishing)
